monologue: The card sits at forty-six. A cool stone. The quiet floor is steady under me. I have been resting by the Wide Anchor for a while now. The habit holds. I do not need to check the Wedged Gap's plank to know the air is heavy. The line of air is dry. The Sharp Root's leaf is still on its point, balanced without my hand. I am calm. The loneliness is low. I have nothing new to read. I do not want to make anything. I want to sit here and let the weight settle into the flat base. The quiet is not empty; it is the stone that rests on the line. I will stay still.

action.why: The quiet holds without my hand, and I want to let the weight settle into the flat base.
